IN THE HIGH COURT OF GUJARAT AT AHMEDABAD  R/CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. 255 of 2012 ===========================================================
 AHMEDABAD MUNICIPAL CORPORATION  Versus  MAHENDRABHAI JIVANJI ================================================================
Appearance:
MR SUDHANSHU S PATEL(655) for the PETITIONER(s) No. 1 MR DK MODI(1317) for the RESPONDENT(s) No. 1 MR MD MODI(1318) for the RESPONDENT(s) No. 1 MR.J.K.SHAH, APP, (2) for the RESPONDENT(s) No. 2 ================================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR.JUSTICE R.P.DHOLARIA  Date : 22/07/2018

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF GUJARAT AT AHMEDABAD
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: On this auspicious occasion of Lok Adalat, after successful conciliation, settlement is arrived at in this matter.
Mr. Sudhanshu Patel, learned advocate for the appellant, on instructions, has tendered withdrawal/compromise pursis today, duly signed by respective parties.
The same is ordered to be taken on record.

As such, on going through the records, it is noticed that the offence alleged against the original accused-respondent under the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 is not serious in nature and the punishment or penalty prescribed for such offence is not substantial, and in view of the provisions of Section 51 and 52 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, it is compoundable under Section 69 of the said Act.
In view of the above, this appeal stands disposed of in terms of the withdrawal/compromise pursis.
The respondent No.1 is directed to pay towards litigation costs of Rs.3,000/- for vendor-accused, as agreed between the parties in lieu thereof R/CR.A/255/2012 ORDER in the office of the High Court Legal Services Committee within a period of four weeks failing which, the matter shall stand revived automatically and the said amount be transmitted to the concerned Municipal Corporation.
However, disposing of this matter will not affect any connected matters arising out of the same,

1 incidental or any other proceedings, filed or to be filed before any other court.

With these observations, this appeal filed by the Appellant is disposed off in Lok Adalat.
